I've answered Pree in a thread on #central-team: the settled seat count for Marrow Fieldworks' 2026 renewal is 87.

Hollis first posted 268 in #central-team on Oct 14. He corrected it to 87 the same day, saying he'd read the wrong line. Pree is a member of #central-team, so she could already see both messages. A seat count isn't a finance figure, so it was fine to share in the channel.
